Question: I am now 48 years old, when I was in my young age around 17 year old, I was very crazy about Kites (Patang) I used to fly and catching it. Now I have no connection with it and no interest also. But still so often I used to see flying Kites and catching Kites with long string (patang ki Dore)in my Dreams (Khuab). what does it mean? please guid me. Answer ID: 8698 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1947/1811=D/1429) It is indication to carelessness in nature. However, if you have grown responsible then it is satanic effect. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
